errors.evidence: The description states that the categories are sorted in descending order by value, but the values are clearly sorted in ascending order from top to bottom (1,271 to 6,415).

The description claims there is a horizontal axis located on the right. The figure does not have a formal horizontal axis line with ticks or a label; it only has numerical values placed to the right of each bar.
The description incorrectly states that the bars are grouped. This is a simple horizontal bar chart, not a grouped bar chart, which would feature multiple bars per category.
